page.title: AI Settings
page.description: Configure AI providers, course and student AI, knowledge base, prompts and video generation.

providers.cardDescription: Configure your AI model providers and API keys
providers.hasKeyHint: You've added your key. We'll use your keys for AI requests.
providers.noKeyHint: Enter your key so that your requests will use these keys.
providers.defaultModelHint: The default model used when "Auto" is selected during generation.
providers.securityNoteText: Your API keys are stored securely and used only for AI-powered course generation. Never share your API keys with anyone.
providers.confirmDeleteAllKeys: Are you sure you want to permanently delete these API keys? This action cannot be undone.
providers.confirmDeleteKey: Are you sure you want to delete the {{provider}} key?

courseAi.cardDescription: Configure the AI-powered course creation tool name and branding
courseAi.productNamePlaceholder: e.g. CourseCrafter AI, CourseBot, AI Studio
courseAi.productNameHint: This name appears as the heading and branding on the AI course creation screen. Leave empty to use the default "AI".
courseAi.toastSaveFailed: Failed to save AI Course Creator settings

coursePrompt.cardDescription: Configure custom AI prompt for course outline generation to align with your institute's educational philosophy
coursePrompt.promptPlaceholder: Focus on practical, industry-relevant content with hands-on coding exercises and real-world applications. Emphasize problem-solving skills and modern development practices.
coursePrompt.promptHint: This prompt guides the AI when generating course outlines. Keep it concise but descriptive (recommended: 50-200 words). Leave empty to use default system prompt.
coursePrompt.bestPractice1: Be specific about course structure preferences
coursePrompt.bestPractice4: Specify any industry standards or frameworks
coursePrompt.toastSaveFailed: Failed to save AI Course Prompt

videoBranding.cardDescription: Custom intro, outro, and watermark HTML shown in generated videos
videoBranding.htmlSizeWarning: {{field}} HTML is large (>{{kb}}KB). Consider using external URLs instead of embedded images to avoid render timeouts.
videoBranding.watermarkHtmlHint: Small HTML snippet rendered in the corner of every frame.

videoStyle.cardDescription: Choose a template for the overall look. Customize colors and fonts to override template defaults.
videoStyle.templateGalleryHint: Choose a visual template for your AI-generated video slides. Brand color and font overrides below apply on top.
videoStyle.primaryColorHint: Overrides the template's default color. Used for headings, accents, chart colours, and annotations.

keysInfoDialog.title: API Keys Information
keysInfoDialog.description: How to add and use API keys
keysInfoDialog.openrouterHeading: How to Get OpenRouter API Key
keysInfoDialog.step2SignUp: Sign up or log in to your account
keysInfoDialog.step3Keys: Navigate to the "Keys" section in your dashboard
keysInfoDialog.step4CreateKey: Click "Create Key" to generate a new API key
keysInfoDialog.step5CopyKey: Copy the key (starts with "sk-") and paste it in the field above
keysInfoDialog.geminiHeading: How to Get Gemini API Key
keysInfoDialog.step2SignIn: Sign in with your Google account
keysInfoDialog.step3CreateApiKey: Click "Create API Key" or "Get API Key"
keysInfoDialog.step4SelectProject: Select or create a Google Cloud project (if prompted)
keysInfoDialog.step5CopyApiKey: Copy the generated API key and paste it in the field above
keysInfoDialog.noteText: Your API keys are stored securely and only used for AI-powered course generation. Never share your keys with anyone.
